snippet.description:
Samiksha Dwivedi (AIR 56) expected a lower rank, believing her optional and GS performance might limit her score. She had started expecting less from herself, not because she had stopped working hard, but because she had accepted whatever result came her way. When the result came, she received much more than she had expected.
